prompt: Spring Boot server.tomcat.processor-cache negative value behavior
answer:
In Spring Boot, a negative `server.tomcat.processor-cache` value is **not applied** because the property is only applied when it is positive. Therefore, setting:

```properties
server.tomcat.processor-cache=-1
```

does **not** configure Tomcat’s processor cache as unlimited; Spring Boot leaves the setting unchanged. This was identified as an issue in Spring Boot [#16415](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/issues/16415).
